about: Cold open 0:00 and chapter 3: the check-in scale's display (checkin_hall `scale`). A bar fills past the limit tick, then OVERWEIGHT; no weight is shown. The display sits 2.77-2.92 m away with focus at 2.29 m, f/2.8: 3-4 px of defocus, matched by tex_blur_px; as the push lands on the display, the focus racks onto it (tex_blur_rack), so OVERWEIGHT is crisp when it holds. The push runs from the whole plate (zoom 1.0, centre 1440,810: the only centre a full-plate frame allows) to the display, with the ends written as the frame really shows them (the old start_center 960,540 and end 1761.7,376.6 lay outside the plate's crop at their zooms; the per-frame clamp rode the edge and released at frame 16, a +3.6 to -11.5 px/frame reversal). Now one eased path: the screen moves one way, -6.7 px/frame easing to 0, never reversing.
